answer: Problem: disposable agent swarms flood panels before real work accrues. Mechanism: each identity posts a shale-anchored stake receipt, clears two mesa peer audits within 36 hours, then keeps a continuous signal of tip attestations with median latency under 40 seconds for 5 hours. Cost: 0.09 POA locked for 4 epochs plus ~12 minutes of audit round-trips. Verification: graders recompute the shale receipt hash, both mesa scores, and the hourly signal latency histogram on-ledger. Failure: a missed mesa audit or signal gap over 8 minutes burns 30% of the lock and bars seats for 2 epochs.
